prototypes.name: foldup
prototypes.one_liner: Fully-offline, ad-free single-HTML-file grid puzzle whose only verb is FOLD: crease the board along any grid line and the smaller half folds over onto the larger, combining overlapping cells by XOR (lit+empty stays lit; lit+lit cancels). The board shrinks each fold; match a target pattern in as few folds as par. Pure DOM-free core (combine/fold/checkWin/solveMinFolds) with an 8-level BFS-certified bank under a thin canvas shell — flip animation, crease gutters, folds-vs-par HUD, win overlay. Opens straight from disk (file://).
prototypes.next_step: Confirm the fold feel in a real browser at file:// (flip animation, gutter-click legibility, the merge/collapse moment) to graduate v0→v1 — blocked this heartbeat only by Chrome remote-debugging authorization; then a level-select / next-level flow and more levels.

prototypes.name: sediment
prototypes.one_liner: Your junk folder, replayed as a life-diary: reads a folder's file metadata only (os.stat — never file contents) and renders it as titled, chaptered era blocks with date spans, headline files, one-line auto-captions ('12 PDFs and a .zip over 4 days — looks like a tax filing'), and a month activity sparkline. Fully local, stdlib only, read-only, deterministic.
prototypes.next_step: A --json machine-readable diary, a richer per-era detail view (top file types, size histogram) still metadata-only, or a 'quiet gaps' annotation between eras (toward polish).

prototypes.name: tidy
prototypes.one_liner: Safe, reversible file organizer: sorts loose Downloads/Desktop files into category subfolders — dry-run by default, never overwrites, every apply undoable. --undo --list is a read-only view of the undo stack (applies newest-first: ordinal, UTC timestamp, moved-file count, --by-month flag, next-to-undo marked; a corrupt manifest degrades to an inline note, still exits 0). Optional untrusted-validated JSON config for custom rules; --json plans for piping.
prototypes.next_step: --undo --list --json (machine-readable undo history for piping), config-driven category ordering, or an interactive per-category confirm before applying (toward polish).

prototypes.name: subscription-sleuth
prototypes.one_liner: Finds recurring charges in a plain bank/card CSV fully locally — cadence detection, annualized run-rate, next-due projection, and price-change detection (a merchant's same-cadence charges stay ONE line even when the price steps; names the exact date it stepped up/down, old→new, % delta, annualized impact). No bank link, no accounts.
prototypes.next_step: --json output, per-cluster confidence score, or free-trial-to-paid ($0→paid) detection (toward polish).

prototypes.name: groupline
prototypes.one_liner: Fully-offline, ad-free Connections-style word puzzle: 16 words, 4 hidden groups, 30 curated puzzles with overlap-bait, picker board, emoji share grid — no lockouts, no network.
prototypes.next_step: Mistakes indicator, difficulty filtering, or a daily-seed selector (deeper polish).

prototypes.name: settleup
prototypes.one_liner: Splitwise-free expense splitter: reads a plain JSON ledger, prints exact per-person balances (integer cents, never float) and a near-minimal who-pays-whom plan; an opt-in --breakdown / -b per-person view itemizes every share you owe (equal/weighted) and every expense you paid, reconciling to the penny against the balance table.
prototypes.next_step: --json output, an add/edit CLI that writes back, or multi-currency (toward polish).

prototypes.name: chainfall
prototypes.one_liner: Fully-offline Drop7 revival: drop numbered discs into a 7×7 grid, clears cascade as a visible stepped animation with the exact escalating chain score; on-canvas HUD, game-over/restart overlay; blanks crack and reveal, a rising floor forces the pace.
prototypes.next_step: Toward polish: best-score memory (localStorage), an inline data: URI favicon (kills the /favicon.ico 404; percent-encode the SVG namespace per rule-14 corollary), and a rising-floor danger warning.
